# Facts: `jl-facts`

The facts about one thing, label and value, the ones without a value left out.

- Class `JlFacts`, a molecule: `import { JlFacts } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/facts

The facts about one thing, each a label and its value: an archived object's kind, size and digest, an
order's customer and date. Give them as JSON in items, in the order people read them. A fact without a value (null
or empty) is left out, so a page can list every fact a thing may have; an element with none takes no room.

A value can be code (monospace, broken anywhere, for identifiers and digests), a link (href), or drawn by code: a
fact with a key is drawn by the renderer of that key in renderers (a badge, links, a list). Labels sit beside
their values and line up in one column; vertical puts each label over its value, the facts side by side, for a
summary under a heading. Narrower than 420 pixels, the labels go over their values either way.

## Use

```ts
import { JlFacts } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlFacts
  items={[{"href":"#customer","label":"Customer","value":"Sara Monnier"},{"code":true,"label":"Job","value":"CH-2026-0160"},{"label":"Sent","value":"25 Oct, 22:47"},{"label":"Items","value":4}]}
  label="Order"
  orientation="horizontal"
/>
```

```html
<jl-facts
  items='[{"href":"#customer","label":"Customer","value":"Sara Monnier"},{"code":true,"label":"Job","value":"CH-2026-0160"},{"label":"Sent","value":"25 Oct, 22:47"},{"label":"Items","value":4}]'
  label="Order"
  orientation="horizontal"
></jl-facts>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `Fact[]`, default `[]`. The facts: label and value, and optionally code (monospace), href (a link), id (a link the app follows: select fires with it), hint (a tooltip) and key (for a renderer). A fact whose value is null or empty is left out.
- `orientation` (attribute `orientation`): `'horizontal' | 'vertical'`, default `'horizontal'`. horizontal puts each label beside its value, vertical over it, the facts side by side.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name of the list for screen readers.
- `renderers` (property only): `Record<string, FactRenderer>`, default `{}`. Draws the values of some facts by code, by the fact's key: (fact) => Node.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `select` (`onSelect` in JSX), detail `string`: A fact with an id and no href was followed: the app goes there itself (a router’s goto).

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The description list.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Followed by the app

A fact with an id instead of an href: the app follows it, as a router would with goto.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-facts class="demo-followed-facts"></jl-facts>
  <span class="muted demo-followed-facts-note">Nothing followed yet</span>
</div>
```

```js
const facts = root.querySelector('.demo-followed-facts');
facts.items.set([
  { label: 'Order', value: '#3' },
  { id: 'customer', label: 'Customer', value: 'Sara Monnier' },
]);
facts.events.register('select', (id) => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-followed-facts-note').textContent = 'Followed: ' + id;
});
```

### Labels beside values

An object of an archive: the deleted fact has no value, so it is left out.

```html
<jl-facts class="narrow" label="Object" items='[{"label":"Kind","value":"BasicContainer"},{"label":"Parent","value":"info:fedora/archive"},{"label":"Size","value":"1.4 MB"},{"code":true,"label":"SHA-512","value":"9b71d224bd62f3785d96d46ad3ea3d73319bfbc2890caadae2dff72519673ca72323c3d99ba5c11d7c7acc6e14b8c5da0c4663475c2e5c3adef46f73bcdec043"},{"label":"Deleted","value":null},{"label":"Created","value":"25 Oct 2026, 22:47"}]'></jl-facts>
```

### Side by side

vertical: each label over its value, the facts side by side.

```html
<jl-facts orientation="vertical" label="Order" items='[{"href":"#customer","label":"Customer","value":"Sara Monnier"},{"code":true,"label":"Job","value":"CH-2026-0160"},{"label":"Sent","value":"25 Oct, 22:47"},{"label":"Items","value":4}]'></jl-facts>
```

### Values drawn by code

renderers draws the value of a fact by its key: here the state as a badge.

```html
<jl-facts class="demo-rendered narrow" label="Ingest"></jl-facts>
```

```js
const facts = root.querySelector('jl-facts');
facts.renderers.set({ state: (fact) => <JlBadge tone="ok" label={fact.value} /> });
facts.items.set([
  { label: 'Package', value: 'Letters 1902' },
  { key: 'state', label: 'State', value: 'Committed' },
]);
```
